summary: Flash flood/debris flow swept Black Hollow Creek in upper Poudre Canyon near Rustic ~6:05 p.m. Tuesday after heavy rain fell on the Cameron Peak Fire burn scar; at least five structures destroyed. Four members of one vacationing family were killed: David Brown 61, Diana Brown 57, Patricia Brown 59, and Richard Brown 85. Three bodies were recovered within days; Diana Brown's body was found Nov 20 by a hiker ~4 miles downstream after the initial search was called off July 28 and a September daylong search failed. Response included Larimer County SAR, Dive Rescue, Colorado DFPC and the USFS plus hundreds of volunteer search hours.
location: Black Hollow Road, Poudre Canyon near Rustic
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Larimer County Dive Rescue Team; Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control; US Forest Service
notes: Cause of death for Diana Brown ruled asphyxia by drowning; family had gathered at the cabin every July. County timeline: day-by-day search/SAR log at Larimer County Poudre Canyon Flooding page. 2026-09-20: merged LCSAR FB post permalink (Post 2021-07-23 describes ongoing Poudre Canyon search operations for 'three people still ).
